services.name: Learn to Sail
services.desc: Skills Improvement sessions may be held some Tuesday evenings throughout the sailing season or Refresher clinics on an ad hoc basis. These are hosted by experienced members of the club and consist of a combination of classroom topics and structured on the water practice. Also, there is a Monday evening race training available which members of all three community clubs are welcome to attend. Come learn some new skills or come practice! Absolutely free. All skill levels welcome. Prerequisite: Completion of CANSail 1 & 2 (at the 2 level) or equivalent. (i.e. Achievement of Helms status.)
